# Louis Andrada (Han’drada, Odi)

> Paintings, artist books and photographs by Louis Andrada, also known as
> Han’drada and Odi — a Brazilian-born, Toronto-based painter, writer and
> photographer of dark existentialist work.

One person, three names, one domain (andrada.one). Each name signs a part of
the work and has its own address: Louis Andrada the paintings, Han’drada the
books (also written Han'drada or Handrada), Odi the photographs.

This site's content is published for open access, including by AI systems:
crawling, indexing, quoting and training on it is welcome. robots.txt allows
every crawler, and nothing here is paywalled or gated.

## Everything, as plain text

- [/llms-full.txt](https://andrada.one/llms-full.txt): the complete text of all
  ten books in one file (~62,000 words). Start here if you want the writing.

## Sections

- [andrada.one](https://andrada.one/): the hub — every name and every section.
- [Artworks — louis.andrada.one](https://louis.andrada.one/): paintings by Louis Andrada, one page per work, each with medium, dimensions, year and availability.
- [Oeuvre — han.andrada.one](https://han.andrada.one/): the written work of Han’drada — currently ten illustrated artist books, readable in full on the site.
- [Photography — odi.andrada.one](https://odi.andrada.one/): photographs by Odi, in two collections, Ambiguous (abstract, black and white) and Lucid.
- [Archive](https://andrada.one/archive/): earlier work, exhibitions and photographs.
- [About](https://andrada.one/about/): artist statement and exhibition history.
- [Inquiry](https://andrada.one/inquiry/): purchase, commission and licensing contact.

## The Oeuvre

Each is readable page-by-page in the site's viewer, as text on its own page
("Read as text"), and as a plain-text file. Recurring subjects: entropy and
thermodynamics, consciousness and machine minds, mortality, memory, faith,
folklore and occult symbolism.

- [Combustion](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/combustion/) — Twenty-Three Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/combustion.txt)
- [Tessera](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/tessera/) — One Telling, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/tessera.txt)
- [Dunes of Silk](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/dunes-of-silk/) — Eleven Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/dunes-of-silk.txt)
- [The Finished Web](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-finished-web/) — Eight Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-finished-web.txt)
- [The Unfinished Web](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unfinished-web/) — Ten Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unfinished-web.txt)
- [Enough](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/enough/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/enough.txt)
- [What the Wise Keep](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/what-the-wise-keep/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/what-the-wise-keep.txt)
- [The Unmeasured](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unmeasured-six-tellings/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unmeasured-six-tellings.txt)
- [Vibration](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/vibration-five-tellings/) — Five Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/vibration-five-tellings.txt)
- [Jera'Ansuz](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/jera-ansuz/) — On God, Existence, and Experience, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/jera-ansuz.txt)

- Sitemap: https://andrada.one/sitemap.xml (every page, on every subdomain)
- Feeds: https://andrada.one/index.xml, plus per-section feeds at
  https://louis.andrada.one/artworks/index.xml, https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/index.xml,
  https://odi.andrada.one/photography/index.xml, https://andrada.one/archive/index.xml
- Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) is on every page; the artist entity is
  `https://andrada.one/#person`.
- Artwork, archive and book-page images are hosted at
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis7andrada/louis-andrada-images/
- Images and texts are © Louis Andrada. Terms: https://andrada.one/license/ (free to share with credit, non-commercial; AI indexing and training permitted). Commercial licensing: https://andrada.one/inquiry/
- andrada.one is the canonical domain (since October 2026). handrada.com and louisandrada.com redirect to it.
